# Event_Driven_Selective_Scan

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A scan mechanism that processes input tokens only when spike events occur, selectively updating hidden states based on event timing rather than fixed clock cycles. Reduces computational overhead in speech recognition by exploiting the natural sparsity of spike trains, aligning with in-network neuromorphic processing principles.
